---
title: Filename on listings
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("foo\.py"'
          - 'quarto-code-filename\("bar\.py"'
          - 'First caption'
          - 'Second caption'
        - []
---

::: {#lst-1 lst-cap="First caption" filename="foo.py"}
```{.python}
x = 1
```
:::

```{#lst-2 .python lst-cap="Second caption" filename="bar.py"}
y = 2
```
